Python Runtime and Toolchain Notice
Repository Notice Scope: Supplemental third-party notice
Related Root Notice Version: 1.0.2

This notice records runtime, packaging, renderer, validation, and
toolchain categories that may be involved in Ludoxel development or
distribution. This notice is a repository-specific supplemental notice.
It does not replace, translate as controlling text, narrow, expand, or
otherwise modify the license text of any dependency, runtime, package,
SDK, or tool.

Ludoxel source-tree execution, validation, desktop building, renderer
backend operation, native extension building, formatting, linting,
resource checking, shader checking, and distribution packaging may
involve CPython, PyQt6, Qt runtime components, NumPy, PyOpenGL, wgpu,
rendercanvas, PyInstaller, Ruff, Node.js, npm packages, ESLint,
Stylelint, Prettier, and other packages or toolchain components.

Those materials are Third-Party Materials unless a specific component is
separately authored by Kento Konishi and identified as Ludoxel Original
Material. Their presence in a development environment, package metadata,
lockfile, build log, validation command, or distribution artifact does
not relicense Ludoxel Original Materials.

Each dependency, runtime, package, SDK, and toolchain component remains
subject to its own license terms, copyright notices, attribution
requirements, warranty disclaimers, reserved names, source-offer
requirements, export restrictions, and redistribution conditions. Before
distributing a Ludoxel artifact, the distributor must confirm the
license obligations that apply to the exact dependency versions and to
the exact form in which those dependencies are bundled, embedded,
required, or otherwise supplied.

This notice does not grant permission to distribute Ludoxel. Ludoxel
distribution is governed by the root LICENSE and requires permission
under that license or a separate written agreement signed by Kento
Konishi.

If a desktop distribution bundles CPython, Qt runtime components,
Python packages, renderer packages, Node packages, or other binary
dependencies, the distribution process must include the legal records
required by those dependencies in addition to the Ludoxel legal
material:

* LICENSE
* NOTICE
* third-party/

This notice is intentionally general because dependency versions and
bundle contents may change between development environments and build
artifacts. A release process must therefore verify actual dependency
versions, actual bundle contents, and actual notice requirements at the
time of distribution.

This notice does not determine whether the license terms of a runtime,
package, SDK, binary component, build tool, renderer package, or Node
package permit distribution in a particular artifact. The distributor
must verify that question against the exact upstream license text and
the exact artifact contents.

This notice does not create an independent version sequence for the
Ludoxel Independent License, the root NOTICE, or any third-party
license. If the root NOTICE is amended before its current version is
committed, this supplemental notice must remain aligned with that root
NOTICE version and must not record a later version number.
